resources.string: The Timer chimes when it runs out.

Three buttons, left to right. Play runs the animation on the real Glyph Matrix, and pause puts the frame you are editing back on it — pressing play, or changing anything at all, also makes this the design the matrix keeps afterwards. The eye hides the preview disc when it sits over what you are drawing. The sliders are Design settings, which we are opening now — repeat, the Essential Key and artwork for the other phone size live behind them, the three easiest things in the editor to miss.
